> import re
> with open('data.hex', 'r') as f:
>     lines = f.read().split('\n')
> lines = [line.strip() for line in lines if line.strip()]
> print('Total lines:', len(lines))
> pattern = re.compile(r'^(\d+)\s+(.+)$')
> bytes_list = []
> for line in lines:
>     m = pattern.match(line)
>     if m:
>         offset = m.group(1)
>         hex_str = m.group(2)
>         # split by whitespace
>         pairs = hex_str.split()
>         for pair in pairs:
>             try:
>                 val = int(pair, 16)
>             except ValueError:
>                 print(f'Invalid hex pair: {pair}')
>                 continue
>             if val < 0 or val > 255:
>                 print(f'Out of range: {pair} -> {val}')
>             bytes_list.append(val)
>             print(f'{val:02x} {val} {pair}')
> print(f'Total bytes: {len(bytes_list)}')
> EOF
